action_vi: Tạo canonical reference candidate cho Chiến Xa Cũ: chiến xa gỗ cổ hư hỏng không người điều khiển, vẫn lao theo tuyến trận cũ; quái hạng nặng/charge.
notes: SELF-REFERENCE CANDIDATE ONLY. Compact ancient fantasy wooden war cart/chariot with weathered wheels, rope and bronze/iron reinforcement, visibly damaged but still mobile. No rider, no horse, no modern vehicle cues. RIGHT-facing charge silhouette with wind-whipped cloth marker. Keep proportions suitable for JRPG battle enemy, not an enormous boss. Full object in frame with generous margin, transparent RGBA delivery. Candidate/non-canon; no animation rows yet.
